column3: MT 4:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; the title phrase לַמְנַצֵּחַ (“to the choirmaster”) is rendered “To the Chief Musician,” and “you have made wide” “You have relieved.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV repeats “How long” in the second line.
Close to the Hebrew; חָסִיד (“the godly, loyal one”) is rendered “him who is godly.”
Close to the Hebrew; רִגְזוּ (“tremble, be agitated”) is rendered “Be angry,” and “speak in your heart” “Meditate within your heart.”
